Main file: Table 3 current values for SOFC, MCFC and PAFC as examples of fuel-cell CHP (process 'Stationary fuel cell systems', all-industry, steam-and-hot-water, GJ): capacity (kWe lower bound), net LHV electrical efficiency (target electricity), LHV overall efficiency (efficiency-chp), lifetime IN HOURS (stack/operating hours, kept as printed), stack operating temperature (NOT delivered-heat temperature), availability, capex per kWe, and SOFC O&M $100/kWe/yr (source says 'assumed'). heat-to-power-ratio is DERIVED (overall minus electrical, over electrical) with a formula; the source prints none. Carrier natural-gas because Table 1's efficiencies are for gas-fuelled systems (Table 3 also lists hydrogen, biogas, landfill gas). Sidecars (not loaded): _micro-chp (PEMFC column and the SOFC $25,000 per 0.7 kWe cell - residential, out of scope); _ene-farm-prices (Table 2); _projections (Table 3 2020-2025 and long-term blocks, plus p.4-5 text targets); _other (MCFC/PAFC O&M per year with no size basis, start times, 2011 shipments, cost shares). Omitted: Table 3 NOx, SOx and PM10 rows (non-GHG pollutants, out of scope; all 'near zero'/'negligible' except MCFC 0.005/0.0005/0.000005 and PAFC 0.016/0/negligible kg/MWh). No CO2 figure is given.
